### State Street Corporation Declares Dividends on Its Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock Series “G,” “I,” “J,” “K,” and “L”


11/12/2026


Download this Press Release (opens in new window)


BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


State Street Corporation (NYSE:STT) today announced a cash dividend on each of the below outstanding series of non-cumulative perpetual preferred stock:


- **Series G** (represented by depositary shares, each representing a 1/4000th interest in a share of Series G preferred stock). The cash dividend is in the amount of $1,352.36 per share of Series G preferred stock (resulting in a distribution of approximately $0.338090 per depositary share) and is payable on December 15, 2026 to the holders of record of the Series G preferred stock at the close of business on December 1, 2026.


- **Series I** (represented by depositary shares, each representing a 1/100th interest in a share of Series I preferred stock). The cash dividend is in the amount of $1,675.00 per share of Series I preferred stock (resulting in a distribution of approximately $16.750000 per depositary share) and is payable on December 15, 2026 to the holders of record of the Series I preferred stock at the close of business on December 1, 2026.


- **Series J** (represented by depositary shares, each representing a 1/100th interest in a share of Series J preferred stock). The cash dividend is in the amount of $1,675.00 per share of Series J preferred stock (resulting in a distribution of approximately $16.750000 per depositary share) and is payable on December 15, 2026 to the holders of record of the Series J preferred stock at the close of business on December 1, 2026.


- **Series K** (represented by depositary shares, each representing a 1/100th interest in a share of Series K preferred stock). The cash dividend is in the amount of $1,612.50 per share of Series K preferred stock (resulting in a distribution of approximately $16.125000 per depositary share) and is payable on December 15, 2026 to the holders of record of the Series K preferred stock at the close of business on December 1, 2026.


- **Series L** (represented by depositary shares, each representing a 1/100th interest in a share of Series L preferred stock). The cash dividend is in the amount of $2,169.58 per share of Series L preferred stock (resulting in a distribution of approximately $21.695800 per depositary share) and is payable on December 15, 2026 to the holders of record of the Series L preferred stock at the close of business on December 1, 2026. This dividend payment is in respect to the dividend period from, and including, August 12, 2026, to, but excluding, December 15, 2026.


**About State Street Corporation**


State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) is one of the world's leading providers of financial services to institutional investors including investment servicing, investment management and investment research and trading. With $59.2 trillion in assets under custody and/or administration and $6.3 trillion* in assets under management as of September 30, 2026, State Street operates globally in more than 100 geographic markets and employs approximately 51,000 worldwide. For more information, visit State Street's website at[www.statestreet.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.statestreet.com&esheet=54640524&newsitemid=20261112133738&lan=en-US&anchor=www.statestreet.com&index=1&md5=e97218564180d7ebe09476a9c7b3eb21) .


**Assets under management as of September 30, 2026 includes approximately $172 billion of assets with respect to SPDR® products for which State Street Global Advisors Funds Distributors, LLC (SSGA FD) acts solely as the marketing agent. SSGA FD and State Street Investment Management are affiliated.*
